arxiv-1804-07832.title: Normalization for planar string diagrams and a quadratic equivalence algorithm Thanks: This work was supported by an EPSRC scholarship.
arxiv-1804-07832.creator: Antonin Delpeuch \rsuper a, Jamie Vicary \rsuper b
arxiv-1804-07832.description: Abstract . In the graphical calculus of planar string diagrams, equality is generated by exchange moves, which swap the heights of adjacent vertices. We show that left- and right-handed exchanges each give strongly normalizing rewrite strategies for connected string diagrams.

arxiv-2009-11457.title: Examples on a Conjecture about Makar-Limanov Invariants of Affine Unique Factorization Domains Thanks: This paper is an undergraduate research work. I thank professor Xiaosong Sun in Jilin University for his help and suggestions when I worked on this paper.
arxiv-2009-11457.creator: Ziqi Liu
arxiv-2009-11457.description: Abstract . The author introduces a conjecture about Makar-Limanov invariants of affine unique factorization domains over a field of characteristic zero. Then the author finds that the conjecture does not always hold when 𝕜 \mathbbm{k} is not algebraically closed and gives some examples where the conjecture holds. 1.

arxiv-2103-13773.title: Multi-asset optimal execution and statistical arbitrage strategies under Ornstein-Uhlenbeck dynamics
arxiv-2103-13773.creator: Philippe Bergault, Fayçal Drissi, Olivier Guéant
arxiv-2103-13773.description: Abstract In recent years, academics, regulators, and market practitioners have increasingly addressed liquidity issues. Amongst the numerous problems addressed, the optimal execution of large orders is probably the one that has attracted the most research works, mainly in the case of single-asset portfolios.

arxiv-2104-00103.title: Universal information of critical quantum spin chains from wavefunction overlaps
arxiv-2104-00103.creator: Yijian Zou
arxiv-2104-00103.description: Abstract Given a critical quantum spin chain, we show how universal information about its quantum critical point can be extracted from wavefunction overlaps. More specifically, we consider overlap between low-energy eigenstates of the spin chain Hamiltonian with different boundary conditions, namely periodic boundary conditions and open boundary conditions.

arxiv-2203-09298.title: Weak error rates of numerical schemes for rough volatility Thanks: This work is partially supported by the ANR via the project ANR-16-CE40-0020-01. The author is indebted to two anonymous referees whose comments helped to substantially improve the presentation.
arxiv-2203-09298.creator: Paul Gassiat
arxiv-2203-09298.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Paul Gassiat. Simulation of rough volatility models involves discretization of stochastic integrals where the integrand is a function of a (correlated) fractional Brownian motion of Hurst index H ∈ ( 0 , 1 / 2 ) H\in(0,1/2) . We obtain results on the rate of convergence in the number of time-steps for the weak error of such approximations, in the special cases when either the integrand is the fBm itself, or the test function is cubic.

arxiv-2303-04681.title: Enhancing Low-resolution Face Recognition with Feature Similarity Knowledge Distillation
arxiv-2303-04681.creator: Sungho Shin, Yeonguk Yu, Kyoobin Lee
arxiv-2303-04681.description: Abstract In this study, we introduce a feature knowledge distillation framework to improve low-resolution (LR) face recognition performance using knowledge obtained from high-resolution (HR) images. The proposed framework transfers informative features from an HR-trained network to an LR-trained network by reducing the distance between them.

arxiv-2303-05017.title: Topological two-band electron-hole superconductors with d -wave symmetry: Absence of Dirac quasiparticle annihilation in magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene
arxiv-2303-05017.creator: Senne Van Loon, C. A. R. Sá de Melo
arxiv-2303-05017.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Senne Van Loon, C. A. R. Sá de Melo. We discuss a two-band model for two-dimensional superconductors with electron and hole bands separated by an energy gap and singlet d d -wave pairing in each band. This type of model exhibits a V-shaped to U-shaped transition in the density of the states of the superconductor, and was phenomenologically used as a possible interpretation of recent tunneling experiments in magic-angle twisted trilayer graphene (MATTG) [Kim et al. , Nature 606 , 494-500 (2022)].

arxiv-2308-07643.title: Multiwavelength Observations of the Blazar PKS 0735+178 in Spatial and Temporal Coincidence with an Astrophysical Neutrino Candidate IceCube-211208A
arxiv-2308-07643.creator: and K. Mori
arxiv-2308-07643.description: Abstract We report on multiwavelength target-of-opportunity observations of the blazar PKS 0735+178, located 2.2 degrees away from the best-fit position of the IceCube neutrino event 211208A. The source was in a high-flux state in the optical, ultraviolet, X-ray, and GeV gamma-ray bands around the time of the neutrino event, exhibiting daily variability in the soft X-ray flux.

arxiv-2407-14218.title: Multi-robot maze exploration using an efficient cost-utility method
arxiv-2407-14218.creator: Manousos Linardakis, Iraklis Varlamis, Georgios Th. Papadopoulos
arxiv-2407-14218.description: Abstract . In the field of modern robotics, robots are proving to be useful in tackling high-risk situations, such as navigating hazardous environments like burning buildings, earthquake-stricken areas, or patrolling crime-ridden streets, as well as exploring uncharted caves. These scenarios share similarities with maze exploration problems in terms of complexity.

arxiv-2501-00937.title: Partitions of unity and barycentric algebras
arxiv-2501-00937.creator: Anna Zamojska-Dzienio
arxiv-2501-00937.description: Abstract . Barycentric coordinates provide solutions to the problem of expressing an element of a compact convex set as a convex combination of a finite number of extreme points of the set. They have been studied widely within the geometric literature, typically in response to the demands of interpolation, numerical analysis and computer graphics.

arxiv-2503-07233.title: Narrow absorption lines from intervening material in supernovae
arxiv-2503-07233.creator: Santiago González-Gaitán, Claudia P. Gutiérrez, Gonçalo Martins, Tomás E. Müller-Bravo, João Duarte, Joseph P. Anderson, Lluis Galbany, Mark Sullivan, João Rino-Silvestre, Mariona Caixach, Antonia Morales-Garoffolo, Sabyasachi Goswami, Ana M. Mourão, Seppo Mattila
arxiv-2503-07233.description: Abstract The interstellar medium (ISM) has a number of tracers such as the Na i D λ ​ λ \lambda\lambda 5890, 5896 absorption lines that are evident in the spectra of galaxies but also in those of individual astrophysical sources such as stars, novae or quasars.

europmc-pmc6193947.creator: Pennington KL, Chan TY, Torres MP, Andersen JL.
europmc-pmc6193947.description: 14-3-3 proteins are a family of structurally similar phospho-binding proteins that regulate essentially every major cellular function. pmc-11298988.title: X‐linked ichthyosis presenting with cryptorchidism for orchidopexy: A rare anesthetic encounter and case report
pmc-11298988.creator: Sunil Bhatta, Sukriti Pandit, Pratik Chaudhary, Naresh Thapa Chhetri
pmc-11298988.description: Key Clinical MessageCutaneous scaling and associated clinical syndrome displayed in X‐linked ichthyosis mandates multidisciplinary care. Patient with ichthyosis confronts a numerous challenge to an anesthesiologist and demands a rigorous management. As these patients are very vulnerable perioperatively, meticulous care and support are utmost.AbstractIchthyosis is a group of genetic conditions distinguished by the appearance of hyperkeratotic scales on the skin's surface.

pmc-11484396.title: Comprehensive atlas of mitochondrial distribution and dynamics during oocyte maturation in mouse models
pmc-11484396.creator: Xia Hao, Jian Zhao, Kenny A. Rodriguez-Wallberg
pmc-11484396.description: BackgroundOocytes, the largest cells in mammals, harbor numerous mitochondria within their cytoplasm. These highly dynamic organelles are crucial for providing energy resources and serving as central regulators during oogenesis. Mitochondrial dynamics ensure proper energy distribution for various cellular processes involved in oocyte maturation. Previous studies have used alterations in mitochondrial distribution as a biomarker to assess the oocyte health.

pmc-11510901.title: Unusual Unsatisfactory Treatment in Two Patients with Imported Cutaneous Leishmaniasis
pmc-11510901.creator: Anna Kuna, Romuald Olszański, Beata Szostakowska, Natalia Kulawiak, Ravi Kant, Maciej Grzybek
pmc-11510901.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Cutaneous leishmaniasis is one of the most commonly diagnosed dermatological condition in travel medicine after diarrhoeal diseases and febrile status. The disease is transmitted by Phlebotomus and Lutzomyia sandflies. It appears in various clinical forms, the most common of which is a painless ulcer with raised edges, usually present on exposed parts of the body on the side where the insect bite occurred. Annually, over a million new cutaneous leishmaniasis (CL) cases are reported globally.

pmc-11607386.title: Enhanced Mn(II)/peracetic acid by nitrilotriacetic acid to degrade organic contaminants: Role of Mn(V) and organic radicals
pmc-11607386.creator: Yiqing Liu, Runyu Zhou, Yuqi Tang, Xin Li, Linghan Xu, Yongsheng Fu
pmc-11607386.description: In this work, it was found that the presence of nitrilotriacetic acid (NTA) could enhance the elimination of sulfamethoxazole (SMX) significantly in Mn(II)/peracetic acid (PAA) process. NTA firstly complexed with Mn(II) to produce Mn(II)-NTA complex, which could activate PAA producing CH3C(O)O· and Mn(III)-NTA complex. Subsequently, Mn(V) was generated via two-electron transfer between Mn(III)-NTA complex and PAA.

pmc-12481158.title: Membrane contact sites between chloroplasts and the pathogen interface underpin plant focal immune responses
pmc-12481158.creator: Enoch Lok Him Yuen, Zachary Savage, Vojtěch Pražák, Zhongyuan Liu, Vanda Adamkova, Freddie King, Cristina Vuolo, Tarhan Ibrahim, Yijun Wang, Saskia Jenkins, Yuanyang Zhou, Yasin Tumtas, Jessica Lee Erickson, Jennifer Prautsch, Andrada I Balmez, Johannes Stuttmann, Cian Duggan, Francesco Rivetti, Cam
pmc-12481158.description: Communication between cellular organelles is essential for mounting effective innate immune responses. The transport of organelles to pathogen penetration sites and their assembly around the host membrane, which delineates the plant–pathogen interface, are well documented. However, whether organelles associate with these specialized interfaces, and the extent to which this process contributes to immunity, remain unknown.

pmc-12608506.title: Accuracy of Emergency Physician-Performed Echocardiography for Diastolic Dysfunction in Suspected Acute Heart Failure: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis
pmc-12608506.creator: Shao-Min Huang, Yu-Hsuan Yeh, Cheuk-Kwan Sun, Hsuan-Wei Chu, Michael Christ, Yale Tung-Chen
pmc-12608506.description: Background: This study compared the accuracy of diagnosing left ventricular diastolic dysfunction (DD) between emergency physician (EP)-performed focused cardiac ultrasound (FCU) and cardiologist-interpreted reference standards in adult patients presenting to the emergency department (ED) with suspected acute heart failure (HF).

pmc-13087113.title: Deep learning-enhanced shoreline dynamics and vulnerability assessment in Niger Delta area of Nigeria
pmc-13087113.creator: Victor Chukwuemeka Nnam, Joseph O. Odumosu, Ikwueze Uche, Souleman Lamidi
pmc-13087113.description: The Niger Delta region of Nigeria faces escalating coastal erosion and shoreline retreat, threatening ecosystems, infrastructure, and livelihoods. This study presents an integrated geospatial methodology combining deep learning-based shoreline detection, multi-temporal satellite imagery, and statistical modeling to assess coastal vulnerability and shoreline evolution.

pmc-13219400.title: Direction-specific enhanced diffusion of CO2 in chiral hexagonal boron nitride nanotubes
pmc-13219400.creator: Manh-Thuong Nguyen, David J. Heldebrant, Jian Liu, Abhoyjit S. Bhown, Zhijie Xu
pmc-13219400.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). To meet performance requirements, the next generation of gas separation membranes will need both high gas permeability and selectivity, attainable if we could coax adsorbates to minimize random Brownian motion and produce direction-specific diffusion along a desired axis. In this atomistic modeling study, we detail how direction-specific diffusion of CO2 can be achieved in chiral hexagonal boron nitride nanotubes (hBNNTs) by means of a non-Knudsen diffusion mechanism.

pmc-13246417.title: Clove (Syzygium aromaticum) and its bioactive constituent eugenol alleviate psoriatic inflammation by modulating the IL-36/IL-17A axis: a proteomic and mechanistic study
pmc-13246417.creator: Tin-Yun Ho, Hsin-Yi Lo, Chiao-Che Chen, Hui-Chi Huang, Chien-Yun Hsiang
pmc-13246417.description: IntroductionClove (Syzygium aromaticum) is traditionally used for inflammatory skin disorders; however, its specific molecular mechanisms in psoriasis remain poorly defined. This study aimed to evaluate the efficacy of clove extract and its major component, eugenol, and to identify their molecular targets.MethodsWe used an imiquimod (IMQ)-induced mouse model to assess the effects of oral clove extract and eugenol.

pmc-13454566.title: Short-term intraocular pressure changes following intravitreal aflibercept 8 mg versus 2 mg in diabetic macular edema: a prospective observational study
pmc-13454566.creator: Ken Hoshiyama, Takao Hirano, Erika Sekiya, Shingo Kajiwara, Shuji Mukawa, Yoshiaki Chiku, Marie Nakamura, Noriko Yoshida, Toshinori Murata
pmc-13454566.description: This prospective observational study evaluated short-term intraocular pressure (IOP) changes and safety following intravitreal injection of aflibercept 8 mg versus 2 mg in diabetic macular edema (DME). We included 40 eyes from 36 patients with center-involving DME, with 18 patients and 20 eyes in each group.

pmc-13632942.title: Association Between Periodontal Health and Perioperative Glycemic Outcomes in Diabetic Patients Undergoing Dental Procedures Under General Anesthesia: A Retrospective Cohort Study
pmc-13632942.creator: Pritha Negi, Tulasi R Jangala, Tanveer Karpe, Deeksha Kallala, Anupama Betigeri, Maitri Vipulkumar Doshi
pmc-13632942.description: IntroductionPeriodontitis and diabetes are closely related, but the influence of periodontal disease severity on perioperative glycemic outcomes during dental procedures under general anesthesia remains unclear. This study evaluated the association between periodontal disease severity and perioperative glycemic outcomes in diabetic patients.
